feeds.title: Marketing Dive
feeds.description: Marketing Dive provides in-depth journalism covering the most impactful news shaping the marketing industry. They cover topics like social media, video marketing, mobile, data and analytics, technology, and more

feeds.title: Marketing Tech News
feeds.description: MarketingTech pulls in the most insightful, informative and up to the minute blogger content from leading websites around the web, providing access to the latest thought leadership on technological developments from across the global marketing industry.

feeds.title: DM News
feeds.description: The DMNews website focuses on the latest trends and news in digital marketing, offering insights into various marketing strategies and technologies. It covers topics such as advertising, AI technology, data analytics, content marketing, customer experience, and social media marketing. The site also provides resources like eBooks, podcasts, and webinars to help professionals stay updated with the industry's best practices and innovations.

feeds.title: Social Media Today » Facebook
feeds.description: Social Media Today is a leading industry publication operated by Industry Dive. They bring together news, trends, and best practices around enterprise social and digital marketing.

feeds.title: CMSWire
feeds.description: CMSWire, published by Simpler Media Group, Inc, is read by over 3 million influential digital and marketing executives a month. Our daily updates keep you in the know about digital customer experience, digital workplace technologies and practices, and the latest on intelligent information management.

feeds.title: Search Engine Land
feeds.description: Covers all aspects of digital marketing, advertising technology and the martech landscape. Daily news coverage includes breaking stories, industry trends, feature announcements and product changes at popular platforms used by search marketers to reach consumers online. It also features articles by subject matter experts filled with practical tips, tactics and strategies for running successful marketing programs.

feeds.title: American Marketing Association
feeds.description: American Marketing Association is the essential professional community for marketers. They are striving to be the most relevant force and voice shaping marketing around the world.

feeds.title: Search Engine Journal
feeds.description: Launched in 2003, SEJ is unique in its community-based approach to search marketing content. Search Engine Journal is dedicated to producing the latest search news, interviews, the best guides, and how-tos for the SEO and marketer community from marketing experts around the world.

feeds.title: MediaPost » Media Daily News
feeds.description: MediaPost Publications is an on-line publishing resource for all advertising media professionals - TV, cable, radio, print, interactive, agencies, buyers, and reps - providing news, articles and commentary.

feeds.title: Marketing Communication News
feeds.description: Marketing Communication News is an online hub showcasing the global marketing and communication industry's content, projects, and stories. The website features Advertising, Digital, Design, Branding, Direct, Marketing, Mobile, and PR projects and stories submitted from around the Globe.

feeds.title: media update
feeds.description: Media update publishes the latest South African public relations, marketing, media & social media industry news.

feeds.title: The Content Marketing Association News
feeds.description: The industry body for content marketing, the Content Marketing Association promotes the use of content as an effective marketing tool and showcases the range of channels that can be used to engage customers, from digital to video, branded TV, and the more traditional customer magazines.

feeds.title: Digiday
feeds.description: Digiday, a division of Digiday Media, takes a global view of the media and marketing industries and confronts the truths in technology's disruption of these industries. Digiday publishes every day, across the world. We believe in quality over quantity and honesty over spin.

feeds.title: Social Media Examiner
feeds.description: Covers articles about social media marketing, ads, view points, expert interviews, tutorials and more. Social Media Examiner helps millions of marketers master social media marketing to find leads, generate awareness, increase sales and improve branding using Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, Pinterest and more.

feeds.title: ET Brand Equity » Marketing
feeds.description: ET Brand Equity brings the latest Marketing news, online Marketing information, views & updates. Get online news from the Indian Marketing industry.

feeds.title: Adweek
feeds.description: Breaking News in Advertising, Media and Technology. Adweek is the leading source of news and insight serving the brand marketing ecosystem.

feeds.title: Supermarket News » Grocery Marketing
feeds.description: Supermarket News delivers competitive intelligence, news, and information. Covers what food retailers are doing in marketing and merchandising to ensure consumers are buying what their stores are selling.

feeds.title: ClickZ
feeds.description: ClickZ provides insight and analysis on the latest trends, tools and technology in digital marketing and advertising. ClickZ has grown to be one of the largest digital marketing communities in the world today. Alongside the growth of Facebook, YouTube and more, ClickZ has been there, providing the latest news, insights and intelligence along the way.

feeds.title: Media Makers Meet
feeds.description: Discover digital publishing news including advertising technology, managing audiences, optimizing programmatic revenue, and reaching monetization goals.
